@realm:     Mentalism
@name:      Body Shifting
@category:  Training Package

# Format: <level> | <spell_name> | <area_effect> | <duration> | <range> | <type>
# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.

 1 | Study Plant | 1 plant | P | 100' | P
 2 | Study Animal | 1 animal | P | 100' | P
 3 | Size Shift | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U

 5 | Study Person | 1 being | P | 100' | P
 6 | Face Shift | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
 7 | Body Shift | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
 8 | Study Beast | 1 Beast | P | 100' | P
 9 | Plant Shift | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U

14 | Person Shift | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
15 | Beast Shift I | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
16 | Plant Shift True | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
17 | Partial Shift II | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
18 | Beast Shift II | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
19 | Animal Shift True | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
20 | Race Shift True | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
25 | Person Shift True | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
30 | Beast Shift True | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
50 | Shapeshifting True | caster | 24 hours | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of plant for use with other
spells on this list.
@@ 2
Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of animal for use with other
spells on this list.
@@ 3
Caster can either increase his mass (and usually height) by 10% or reduce his
mass (and usually height) by 10% per level (to a maximum of 90%). When
increasing, there is no proportional increase in strength other than for
movement purposes; when decreasing there is no proportional decrease in
strength.
@@ 4
Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of humanoid race for use
with other spells on this list.
@@ 5
Caster studies and memorizes the form of one specific individual of a given
humanoid race for use with other spells on this list.
@@ 6
Allows the caster to alter the features of his face in his current form. If he
has used Study Person on a being, he can take on that being’s exact facial
form.
@@ 7
Allows the caster to alter his build in his current form (down to one-half and
up to double current mass). If he has used Study Person on a being, he can
take on that being’s exact physical build.
@@ 8
Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of magical, mythical, or
legendary beast (e.g., Dragon, Unicorn, etc.) for use with other spells on
this list.
@@ 9
Caster can shift his form to that of any one plant he has studied. The caster
will look and feel like the plant, and will gain the scent and physical
abilities of the plant.
@@ 10
Caster can shift his form to that of any one land-bound animal he has studied.
The caster will look and feel like the animal, and will gain the scent,
physical abilities, and movement abilities of the animal.
@@ 11
As Animal Shift I, except that the caster can shift to the form of a flying,
gliding, or aquatic animal he has studied. Caster will gain the flight
capabilities and/or water breathing abilities (increased lung capacity/gills)
of the studied animal.
@@ 12
Caster can shift his form to that of any one humanoid race he has studied. The
caster will look and feel like a member of that race, and will gain the scent,
and movement abilities associated with that race. Includes flight capabilities
and/or water breathing abilities if pertinent.
@@ 13
Allows the caster to alter exterior parts of his body such as skin color,
hands to claws (or vice versa), adding/removing limbs or tails, etc. Caster
may only make alterations using components of stored patterns (thus, a caster
could only add a reptilian tail if he had previously stored a creature or
being with a reptilian tail).
@@ 14
As Race Shift, except that the caster can shift his form to that of any one
specific individual he has studied.
@@ 15
Caster can shift his form to that of any one landbound legendary, magical, or
mythical beast he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the beast,
and will gain the scent, physical abilities, and movement abilities of the
beast.
@@ 16
As Plant Shift, except the caster also gains any perceptive abilities,
movement abilities, physical attacks, and armor type of the studied plant.
@@ 17
As Partial Shift I, except the caster can alter the internals of his body
(e.g., adjusting his eyes and brain for infravision, adding gills for
underwater breathing, acquiring superior resistance to poison etc.), and
alterations can only be made using components of stored patterns. Thus, a
caster would need an Elf pattern stored, say, to alter his vision for
Nightvision.
@@ 18
As Beast Shift I, except that the caster can shift to the form of a flying,
gliding, or aquatic beast he has studied. Caster will gain the flight
capabilities and/or water breathing abilities (increased lung capacity/gills)
of the studied beast.
@@ 19
As either Animal Shift I or Animal Shift II, except the caster also gains the
perceptive abilities, physical attacks, and natural armor type of the studied
animal.
@@ 20
As Race Shift, except the caster also gains the perceptive abilities, racial
physical abilities, any natural physical attacks (natural weaponry only ), and
natural armor type of the studied race.
@@ 25
As Person Shift, except the caster also gains the perceptive abilities, racial
physical abilities, any natural physical attacks, and natural armor type of
the studied individual’s race. At GM discretion, the caster may also gain any
purely physical talents possessed by the studied individual, and/ or physical
stat bonuses and penalties from the race.
@@ 30
As Beast Shift I or Beast Shift II, except the caster also gains the
perceptive abilities, physical attacks, and natural armor type of the studied
beast.
@@ 50
As any of the lower level Shiftspells except the caster can change form to any
Studiedform (by concentrating for one round) at any time during the duration
of this spell.
